'''Landing area A3''' was part of [[Kinkosa Starport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirtania]]. A [[freighter]] belonging to an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] team berthed at landing area A3 during a mission to acquire [[Shiarha Root]] to cure an outbreak of [[Direllian Plague]].
